name: gpd-arxiv
description: Optional MCP-2-native arXiv bridge. Advertises the fixed research tools search_papers, download_paper, list_papers, read_paper, get_abstract and adds GPD download_source for raw source archives.
prerequisites: Install GPD before enabling built-in MCP servers.
Install GPD with the `arxiv` Python extra in the same environment before enabling gpd-arxiv.

python_module.notes: Replace `${GPD_PYTHON}` with a Python >=3.11 interpreter that has GPD installed.

availability_condition: Available only when the optional Python module 'arxiv' is installed.
